description: This file defines a CMake function 'GetExternalCode' that automates the process of retrieving code from a remote Git repository during the build configuration. It handles cloning, checking out specific versions, and optionally forcing a re-clone, by parsing arguments and invoking Git commands.

methods.name: GetExternalCode
methods.description: A CMake function to clone a Git repository, check out a specific version, and optionally force re-cloning during the build configuration.
